only_lead.title: UPnP control-URL SSRF (MEDIUM)
only_lead.where: net/portmapper/upnp.go:245-280 getUPnPRootDevice pins FIRST fetch to gateway IP, but controlURL/eventSubURL/SCPDURL inside device XML are used by goupnp WITHOUT re-validation -> SOAP POSTs go where XML says.
only_lead.why_medium: netns.NewDialer binds to physical iface (loopback likely unreachable); no exfil channel back to attacker; attacker is the gateway (already on-path).
only_lead.confirm: audit goupnp v1.3.0 URL resolution; test whether netns dialer permits 169.254.169.254.
